gloss: hot spring resort area; spa town

definitions.gloss: hot spring resort area; spa town
definitions.explanation: A locality known for its hot springs, typically with multiple inns, bathhouses, and tourist facilities centered on bathing.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{温泉地|おんせんち}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to a famous hot spring resort.

examples.japanese: この{温泉地|おんせんち}には{昔|むかし}ながらの{旅館|りょかん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This hot spring town has many traditional ryokan.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|こうよう}の{季節|きせつ}には、{温泉地|おんせんち}は{観光客|かんこうきゃく}でにぎわう。
examples.english: During the autumn foliage season, hot spring resort areas bustle with tourists.

notes:
Compound of {温泉|おんせん} (hot spring) + {地|ち} (place, area). Refers to the whole resort town or region, not a single bath.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有名|ゆうめい}な{温泉地|おんせんち}: a famous hot spring resort
- {温泉地|おんせんち}を{巡|めぐ}る: to tour hot spring resorts
- {人気|にんき}の{温泉地|おんせんち}: a popular spa town
- {山間|さんかん}の{温泉地|おんせんち}: a mountain hot spring resort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {温泉|おんせん}: hot spring — the spring or bath itself, not the surrounding town
- {温泉街|おんせんがい}: hot spring district — emphasizes the streets and shops around the springs
